claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + passive_property family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No MagicItemRecord exists in UnitRecord. Magic items that are always-on while worn need a new top-level record kind and a new mechanics family distinct from spell/class-feature/mastery activation patterns.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense surface type (darkvision with range)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom inventory lists grant_sense but types.ts has no surface type expressing it. A darkvision grant requires a sense kind (darkvision) and a range in feet.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Darkvision out to 60 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: conditional sense extension: grant if absent, extend if present
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has two branches: grant 60ft darkvision if the wearer lacks it, or extend existing darkvision by 60ft. This conditional-extension pattern does not map to any existing effect atom or surface shape.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_goggles_of_night.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
